hints.title: Bounded Turns
hints.text: Notice that turn requirements decrease by 1 each round: Alice takes 10, Bob takes 9, Alice takes 8, and so on. The entire game lasts at most 10 rounds.

hints.title: Turn Simulation
hints.text: Maintain the current stones remaining and required stones for the turn. Alternate turns between players.

hints.title: Loss Condition
hints.text: The first player unable to remove the required amount of stones loses. Return whether Alice was the winner.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def canAliceWin(self, n: int) -> bool:
        rem = n
        take = 10
        alice_turn = True
        while rem >= take:
            rem -= take
            take -= 1
            alice_turn = not alice_turn
        return not alice_turn
```

complexity.notes: At most 10 turns can ever be played since 10 + 9 + ... + 1 = 55 stones maximum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulation finishes in at most 10 steps.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory examining turn decrement counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models game turns alternating between Alice and Bob decrementing by 10, 9, 8, etc.
